convention.qubit_indexing: Little-endian: state |q0 q1 ... q_{n-1}> has index sum(q_k * 2^k). Qubit 0 is the least significant bit.

gate_definitions.CNOT: Controlled-NOT: flips target qubit when control qubit is |1>. Format: {control, target}.
gate_definitions.CZ: Controlled-Z: applies phase -1 when both qubits are |1>. Format: {qubits: [q1, q2]}.

convention.pauli_strings: In a Pauli string like 'XZIY', the k-th character (0-indexed) is the Pauli operator acting on qubit k. The full operator is the tensor product P_{n-1} x ... x P_1 x P_0 (qubit 0 rightmost in the Kronecker product).

problem1.task: Simulate the parameterized circuit on 4 qubits (initial state |0000>) and output the final state vector.

output_format.state_vector: List of 16 pairs [real_part, imaginary_part], one per basis state, indexed 0 through 15.

problem2.task: Implement the Quantum Fourier Transform and apply it to each given computational basis input state.

output_format.outputs: List of 3 state vectors. Each state vector is a list of [real, imaginary] pairs.

problem3.task: For each circuit, simulate it starting from |0...0>, then compute the von Neumann entanglement entropy S = -tr(rho_A * ln(rho_A)) for the given bipartition, where rho_A = tr_B(|psi><psi|). Use the natural logarithm.

output_format.entropies: List of 2 floats, one entropy value per circuit.

problem4.task: Implement Grover's search algorithm for a single marked target state on n qubits.
problem4.algorithm: Start in uniform superposition |s> = H^n|0>. Each iteration: (1) Oracle flips the phase of the target state, (2) Diffusion operator 2|s><s| - I. Use optimal iteration count k = floor(pi / (4 * arcsin(1/sqrt(N)))) where N = 2^n.

output_format.iterations: Integer: number of Grover iterations performed.
output_format.probability: Float: probability of measuring the target state after all iterations.

problem5.task: Construct the Hamiltonian matrix from Pauli terms, compute the ground state energy (lowest eigenvalue), then time-evolve a given initial state and compute the expectation value of an observable.

time_evolution.description: Prepare initial state by applying the gates below to |0000>, then evolve under e^{-iHt} for the given time, then compute <psi(t)|O|psi(t)>.

output_format.ground_energy: Float: the lowest eigenvalue of the Hamiltonian matrix.
output_format.evolved_expectation: Float: the expectation value <psi(t)|O|psi(t)> of the observable.
